note: equipment.json - what a new character wears per campaign and profession, imported from ASURA's generated table by tools/import-creation-inventory.py.

information.what a row means: a set is one (campaign, profession) pair and the items the creation screen puts on a character of it. The item fields are the wire's own order, which is what GAME_SMSG_CREATE_NAMED_ITEM writes.
information.where the numbers come from: the reference's GetDefaultEquipments (GmDefaultArmors.c), generated into ASURA crates/asura-world/src/default_equipment.rs.
